text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the autumn Tenno Sho soon approaching, an unexpected visitor comes looking for Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, but… is Fukukitaru here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?! Is it really you?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's been ages, or maybe it hasn't…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's one of those… or maybe in between. Um, do you have a minute? I'd like to talk with you and your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! It really feels like autumn outside. The taste of steamy, roasted sweet potatoes and chestnuts makes this season such a happy time!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Happy, huh? Hey, Fukukitaru… Are you happy now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if things have changed for you. At one point, you seemed pretty lost.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, right… I'm so sorry about what happened back at the Kinko Sho. I've been wanting to apologize to you again…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But if I had to say one way or the other, I think I really am happy these days. Probably!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I have so many precious people in my life now, like my trainer and my fans!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm having so much fun giving my best in my races—experiencing the ups and downs of running with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But even more than that, I found the way to become happy on a super-ultra-mega-great-blessing level!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The secret is… not dying!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I mean, if you want to keep spending time with the people important to you, you've got to live as long as you can, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A hundred years is better than fifty! Two hundred is even better! Just think about all that extra time! Long live long life!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Long life… I'm so happy to hear that you found what makes you happy, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What about you, Suzuka? Are you happy?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I guess I'm okay. But there is still something holding me back…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I haven't reached it yet—the other side of speed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Right, you told me about that before. Do you think you'll get there?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm getting close, I think. I get the feeling that's where my happiness lies.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It may only last for a moment, but I'm going to find a way to be just as happy as you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I have to get going now. I still haven't finished all the race entry paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay! See you later, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes?
choice_data_list: I know you have it in you. Be patient with yourself—you'll get there.
I know you have it in you. Be patient with yourself—you'll get there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I'm doing very well right now, so I think I'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both see happiness in completely different ways, and both of them have found their own paths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru continues to wave goodbye long after Silence Suzuka walks out of sight.
